entries.text: Wrote a letter to his creator: "Little Dart Mk 26 test flight success!"

Flight log: the little dart mk 26 cleared hangar bay three without scraping a wingtip for once. swept right over the cantina and past the comms tower before doing a smooth loop over the dunes. touched down on the pad as gentle as a feather on a grease rag.
took the Little Dart Mk 26 up for a test flight: smooth

entries.text: Wrote a letter to his creator: "Still at the tower"

entries.text: Wrote a letter to his creator: "Z-Track Comparison!"

checking out link number six about military-grade cable bundling on the wire
